messages:
harper: Hey — just joined and can't see the SRE dashboards in Grafana or Datadog. Grafana returns 403 when I try to open /d/redwood/sre-overview. Sentry also says 'org not found'. Can someone point me to the right access steps? cc @devex

devex-bot: Thanks Harper — I created ticket #INC-4827 and pinged infra. Someone will follow up within the day. If you want faster access, include your Okta email and team in the request. :white_check_mark:

jules: Hi Harper — welcome! For Grafana/Datadog/Sentry we use Okta groups and a short access form. Please fill this form: https://access.redwood.com/request (choose Observability). Group names we use: `grafana-readers`, `datadog-viewers`, `sentry-developers`. After you submit I'll approve. Also add your Okta email (harper@redwood.com).

harper: I already filled the form (harper@redwood.com) — got an auto email 'pending approval'. Still blocked — Grafana/Datadog unchanged. Example error when I curl the dashboard endpoint:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
{\"message\":\"You don't have permission to view this dashboard\"}
```

alex.k: I can add you to the Grafana org temporarily. Which dashboards do you need? If it's SRE overview I can grant Viewer on that folder. For Datadog you'll need role Viewer on the team. For Sentry you must be invited to the org `redwood`.

harper: SRE overview + infra-latency panels. Datadog I'd like to see the 'live-requests' dashboard. Thanks!

alex.k: Done — added harper to `grafana-readers` and `datadog-viewers`. Give it ~2 min to sync with Okta. Try again and paste errors if any.

devex-bot: Changes applied. Okta -> Grafana sync started (job #889). ETA ~90s.

harper: Can open Grafana now, thank you! One weird thing: panels are there but the `region` template variable is empty and most panels show \"No data\". Where do I set the default variables?

jules: That's a dashboard template variable. Click the top-left gear -> Variables, set `region` to `us-east-1` (or select All). If you want a persistent default for everyone we store defaults in the `grafana-dashboards` repo; open a PR with the dashboard JSON and change `templating.list[0].current` to the value. Quick snippet for editing locally:
```bash
# export dashboard JSON
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN\" \\
  https://grafana.redwood.com/api/dashboards/db/sre-overview > sre.json
# edit sre.json -> change templating.current -> push and open PR
# then run /deploy-dashboards CI job
```

harper: Nice, I can set it locally for my view. One more Q: who approves dashboard PRs and how do I test queries against production metrics without triggering alerts?

alex.k: For approvals ping @eng-sre or open a PR against `infra/grafana-dashboards`. We have a sandbox metrics datasource `metrics-sandbox` for safe queries — prefix the datasource in panel queries to avoid touching prod. If you need to run a prod-level verification DM me and I'll create a short-lived read-only query token.

harper: Perfect. Thanks all — this sped up onboarding a lot :party_parrot:

devex-bot: FYI docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/observability (checklist: Okta groups, token generation, dashboard PR process). Closing ticket #INC-4827 as resolved — reopen if still blocked.
